name: Coffin Mimic
description: A corridor predator disguised as a child-sized coffin. It opens sideways and uses the lid as a second jaw.

abilities.description: Makes 2 strikes per response. Plating and retaliation apply to each strike.
Restores up to 2 health once after a response that damages player health, if still alive.
